cordis-api:compaction:description.en: Abstract compaction service. Implementations own trigger policy, retention, and summarization, and may consume a separate measurement service. A successful run replaces the selected surface span with one summary node and prevents concurrent compaction of the same session. The replacement user message uses compactCheckpointSource with the transaction identity so consumers recognize and correlate it independently of the backend. Load one implementation per context as `ctx.compaction`.
cordis-api:compaction:description.zh: 抽象压缩服务。实现拥有触发策略、保留与摘要化，并可使用独立的测量服务。成功的运行会用单个摘要节点替换选定的表面跨度，并防止同一会话的并发压缩。替换后的用户消息使用 compactCheckpointSource 携带事务身份，使消费者能够独立于后端识别并关联它。每个上下文加载一个实现作为 `ctx.compaction`。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactIf.en: Consider automatic compaction for one explicit trigger. Pressure policy uses the latest durable routed request, while context-overflow policy may force a useful balanced reduction even below the normal threshold. Return `null` when no safe range can be compacted. A single oversized retained unit or request envelope cannot be repaired through surface compaction.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactIf.zh: 针对一个显式触发考虑自动压缩。压力策略使用最新的持久路由请求，而上下文溢出策略即使低于正常阈值也可能强制进行一次有用且均衡的缩减。当没有可安全压缩的范围时返回 `null`。单个超大保留单元或请求信封无法通过表面压缩修复。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactIf.en: normal pressure or provider-confirmed context overflow.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactIf.zh: 正常压力或提供方确认的上下文溢出。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactIf.en: cancellation signal; model-backed implementations must forward it.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactIf.zh: 取消信号；模型支持实现必须转发它。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactIf.en: the compaction result, or `null` if no compaction was needed.

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.en: Explicitly compact useful history even below automatic pressure thresholds. Implementations synchronously start an idle task before any asynchronous work, select a useful range without writing on a no-op, then append a standalone `compaction/start` before summarization. That durable marker is the compaction lock until one `compaction/end` attempt. Later waking prompts remain accepted in FIFO order and start only after the optional durability checkpoint and idle-task settlement. Context injected while the summary runs may sit between the marker pair; only the selected span must remain stable.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.zh: 即使低于自动压力阈值，也显式压缩有用的历史。实现在任何异步工作之前同步启动一个空闲任务，选择有用范围而在无操作时不写入，然后在摘要化之前追加独立的 `compaction/start`。该持久标记就是压缩锁，直到一次 `compaction/end` 尝试。之后唤醒的提示仍按 FIFO 顺序被接受，并且只在可选的持久性检查点与空闲任务落定之后才开始。摘要运行期间注入的上下文可能位于标记对之间；只有选定的跨度必须保持稳定。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.en: idle agent whose durable history should be compacted.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.zh: 其持久历史应被压缩的空闲代理。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.en: cancellation scoped to this compaction request.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.zh: 作用域限定于本次压缩请求的取消。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.en: initiating command identity for a manual compaction.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.zh: 手动压缩的发起命令身份。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.en: the compaction result, or `null` when no safe useful range exists.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.zh: 压缩结果；当不存在安全的有用范围时为 `null`。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.en: {@link ManualCompactionError} for expected busy, agent-cancellation, changed-span, summarization/shrink, commit-stage, or persistence failures; an aborted request preserves its exact abort reason. Failed attempts remain visible in the log.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactNo.zh: 对于预期中的繁忙、代理取消、跨度变更、摘要化/收缩、提交阶段或持久化失败抛出 {@link ManualCompactionError}；中止的请求保留其确切的中止原因。失败的尝试仍会在日志中可见。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactRe.zh: 最后一个表面 seq，包含。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactRe.en: context whose session is mutated and whose routing options guide summarization.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactRe.zh: 其会话被修改、其路由选项指导摘要化的上下文。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactRe.en: optional cancellation; model-backed implementations must forward it.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactRe.zh: 可选取消；模型支持实现必须转发它。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactRe.en: the appended event seqs, summary, replaced range, and token accounting.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactRe.zh: 追加的事件 seq、摘要、被替换的范围与 token 用量核算。

cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactRe.en: when compaction is active or the range is missing, reversed, or unbalanced.
cordis-api:compaction:abstract compactRe.zh: 当压缩正在进行或范围缺失、颠倒或不均衡时。

cordis-api:credentials:abstract resolve(.en: Resolve one reference to its current value. Resolution is per call: consumers re-resolve at each operation and must not cache across operations — that per-operation read is what makes a changed credential reach the next operation without a restart.
cordis-api:credentials:abstract resolve(.zh: 将一个引用解析为其当前值。解析按调用进行：消费者在每次操作时重新解析，且不得跨操作缓存——正是这种按操作读取让变更后的凭据无需重启即可到达下一次操作。

cordis-api:credentials:abstract resolve(.en: the value and its source, or `undefined` while unconfigured.
cordis-api:credentials:abstract resolve(.zh: 值及其来源；未配置时为 `undefined`。

cordis-api:credentials:abstract describe.en: Describe one reference for configuration surfaces without exposing the value.
cordis-api:credentials:abstract describe.zh: 为配置表面描述一个引用，而不暴露其值。

cordis-api:credentials:abstract describe.en: configured state, supplying source, and writability.
cordis-api:credentials:abstract describe.zh: 配置状态、提供来源与可写性。

cordis-api:directoryPicker:abstract capa.en: the discriminated capability consumers switch on.
cordis-api:directoryPicker:abstract capa.zh: 消费者据以切换的判别式能力。

cordis-api:fs:description.en: Abstract filesystem provider. Targets must preserve identity across aliases; reads expose regular UTF-8 text or typed errors, listings are stable and content-free, and mutations are atomic. Optional guards add stale protection without changing the unguarded provider contract.
cordis-api:fs:description.zh: 抽象文件系统提供方。目标必须跨别名保持身份一致；读取暴露常规 UTF-8 文本或类型化错误，列表稳定且不含内容，变更具有原子性。可选防护在不改变无防护提供方契约的前提下提供过期保护。

cordis-api:fs:abstract resolve(path: str.en: Resolve a model/plugin-supplied path into a stable FsTarget. May perform I/O (a remote/sandboxed backend may need a round-trip to map a path to a stable identity), hence async even though the local backend only normalizes + realpaths.
cordis-api:fs:abstract resolve(path: str.zh: 将模型/插件提供的路径解析为稳定的 FsTarget。可能执行 I/O（远程/沙箱后端可能需要一次往返才能将路径映射为稳定身份），因此即使是本地后端仅做规范化 + realpath 处理，该操作也是异步的。

cordis-api:fs:abstract resolve(path: str.en: the path to resolve; relative paths resolve against `opts.cwd`.
cordis-api:fs:abstract resolve(path: str.zh: 要解析的路径；相对路径基于 `opts.cwd` 解析。

cordis-api:fs:abstract resolve(path: str.en: optional cwd override and cancellation signal.
cordis-api:fs:abstract resolve(path: str.zh: 可选的 cwd 覆盖和取消信号。

cordis-api:fs:abstract resolve(path: str.en: the stable target; the same file yields the same `targetKey`.
cordis-api:fs:abstract resolve(path: str.zh: 稳定目标；同一文件产生相同的 `targetKey`。

cordis-api:fs:abstract processPath(targe.en: the resolved target whose process path is required.
cordis-api:fs:abstract processPath(targe.zh: 需要其进程路径的已解析目标。

cordis-api:fs:abstract contains(parent:.en: Test canonical containment without exposing or parsing backend target keys. Both targets must come from this provider.
cordis-api:fs:abstract contains(parent:.zh: 在不暴露或解析后端目标键的情况下测试规范化包含关系。两个目标都必须来自此提供方。

cordis-api:fs:abstract contains(parent:.en: true when `child` is `parent` or a descendant of it.
cordis-api:fs:abstract contains(parent:.zh: 当 `child` 是 `parent` 或其子孙时返回 true。

cordis-api:fs:abstract stat(target: FsTa.en: Return target metadata, or `undefined` when the target does not exist.
cordis-api:fs:abstract stat(target: FsTa.zh: 返回目标元数据；目标不存在时返回 `undefined`。
要 stat 的已解析目标。

cordis-api:fs:abstract stat(target: FsTa.en: metadata only, never content; undefined for an absent target.
cordis-api:fs:abstract stat(target: FsTa.zh: 仅元数据，绝不含内容；目标不存在时为 undefined。

cordis-api:fs:abstract lstat(path: strin.en: the path to inspect; relative paths resolve against `opts.cwd`.
cordis-api:fs:abstract lstat(path: strin.zh: 要检查的路径；相对路径基于 `opts.cwd` 解析。

cordis-api:fs:abstract lstat(path: strin.en: metadata only, never content; undefined for an absent path.
cordis-api:fs:abstract lstat(path: strin.zh: 仅元数据，绝不含内容；路径不存在时为 undefined。

cordis-api:fs:abstract readText(target:.en: Read the whole regular text file as a single decoded string.
cordis-api:fs:abstract readText(target:.zh: 将整个常规文本文件作为单个已解码字符串读取。
完整的已解码 UTF-8 内容。

cordis-api:fs:abstract streamText(target.en: Stream the whole regular text file as decoded text chunks (same text semantics as readText, for large files). The backend owns cross-chunk UTF-8 decoding and binary rejection so the policy layer never touches raw bytes.
cordis-api:fs:abstract streamText(target.zh: 将整个常规文本文件作为已解码文本数据块流式输出（与 readText 相同的文本语义，适用于大文件）。跨数据块的 UTF-8 解码和二进制拒绝由后端负责，因此策略层绝不会接触原始字节。

cordis-api:fs:abstract streamText(target.en: aborts the stream, including between chunks.
cordis-api:fs:abstract streamText(target.zh: 中止流，包括数据块之间。

cordis-api:fs:abstract streamText(target.en: the chunk iterable, decoded and validated like {@link readText}.
cordis-api:fs:abstract streamText(target.zh: 数据块迭代器，与 {@link readText} 一样经过解码和校验。

cordis-api:fs:abstract readBytes(target:.en: Read the whole regular file as raw bytes with no decoding or binary rejection. The bound lives at this seam so a backend can never buffer an unbounded file: a target known or discovered to exceed `maxBytes` fails with `FS_TOO_LARGE` instead of returning a truncated result.
cordis-api:fs:abstract readBytes(target:.zh: 将整个常规文件作为原始字节读取，不进行解码或二进制拒绝。上限位于此接缝处，因此后端永远不会缓冲无界文件：已知或发现超过 `maxBytes` 的目标会以 `FS_TOO_LARGE` 失败，而不是返回截断结果。

cordis-api:fs:abstract readBytes(target:.en: inclusive byte cap on the complete content.
cordis-api:fs:abstract readBytes(target:.zh: 完整内容的字节上限（含该值）。

cordis-api:fs:abstract readBytes(target:.en: the full raw content, at most `maxBytes` long.
cordis-api:fs:abstract readBytes(target:.zh: 完整的原始内容，长度至多为 `maxBytes`。

cordis-api:fs:abstract listDir(target: F.en: List direct children of a directory in stable name order. Returns resolved child targets plus cheap metadata only; never reads file contents.
cordis-api:fs:abstract listDir(target: F.zh: 按稳定名称顺序列出目录的直接子项。仅返回已解析的子目标及廉价元数据；绝不读取文件内容。

cordis-api:fs:abstract listDir(target: F.en: one entry per direct child, in stable name order.
cordis-api:fs:abstract listDir(target: F.zh: 每个直接子项一个条目，按稳定名称顺序排列。

cordis-api:fs:abstract writeText( target.en: Atomically create or replace UTF-8 text. `expected` guards intent and staleness; omission allows unconditional overwrite.
cordis-api:fs:abstract writeText( target.zh: 原子地创建或替换 UTF-8 文本。`expected` 防护意图与过期性；省略它则允许无条件覆盖。

cordis-api:fs:abstract writeText( target.en: the write intent guarding the write; omit for unconditional.
cordis-api:fs:abstract writeText( target.zh: 防护本次写入的写入意图；省略则为无条件写入。

cordis-api:fs:abstract writeText( target.en: aborts before atomic publication takes effect.
cordis-api:fs:abstract writeText( target.zh: 在原子发布生效前中止。

cordis-api:fs:abstract writeText( target.en: the per-call mode and workspace root this write runs under; a sandboxing backend fences the write by it, the bare backend ignores it. Omit to leave the backend its own default.
cordis-api:fs:abstract writeText( target.zh: 本次写入所依据的每次调用模式与工作区根；沙箱后端据此约束写入，裸后端忽略它。省略则让后端使用自己的默认值。

cordis-api:fs:abstract writeText( target.en: the outcome, including the version the write produced.
cordis-api:fs:abstract writeText( target.zh: 写入结果，包括写入产生的版本。

cordis-api:fs:abstract editText( target:.en: Atomically edit literal text. When supplied, the version guard is checked before matching so stale content reports `FS_STALE_VERSION`; omission edits the current content without a freshness precondition.
cordis-api:fs:abstract editText( target:.zh: 原子地编辑字面文本。提供版本防护时，会在匹配之前进行检查，因此过期内容会报告 `FS_STALE_VERSION`；省略则编辑当前内容，不要求新鲜性前置条件。

cordis-api:fs:abstract editText( target:.en: the version guard; omit for an unconditional edit.
cordis-api:fs:abstract editText( target:.zh: 版本防护；省略则为无条件编辑。

cordis-api:fs:abstract editText( target:.en: aborts before atomic publication takes effect.
cordis-api:fs:abstract editText( target:.zh: 在原子发布生效前中止。

cordis-api:fs:abstract editText( target:.en: the per-call mode and workspace root this edit runs under; a sandboxing backend fences the edit by it, the bare backend ignores it. Omit to leave the backend its own default.
cordis-api:fs:abstract editText( target:.zh: 本次编辑所依据的每次调用模式与工作区根；沙箱后端据此约束编辑，裸后端忽略它。省略则让后端使用自己的默认值。

cordis-api:fs:abstract editText( target:.en: the outcome, including the version the edit produced.
cordis-api:fs:abstract editText( target:.zh: 编辑结果，包括编辑产生的版本。

cordis-api:goals:summary.en: Goal service (`ctx.goals`) backed exclusively by the owning session log.
cordis-api:goals:summary.zh: 目标服务（`ctx.goals`），完全由所属会话日志支撑。

cordis-api:goals:description.en: Goal service (`ctx.goals`) backed exclusively by the owning session log.
cordis-api:goals:description.zh: 目标服务（`ctx.goals`），完全由所属会话日志支撑。

cordis-api:goals:get(agent: Agent): Goal.en: Read the current goal for one exact live agent.
cordis-api:goals:get(agent: Agent): Goal.zh: 读取某个确切活动代理的当前目标。

cordis-api:goals:get(agent: Agent): Goal.en: a fresh view or `undefined` when no goal is current.
cordis-api:goals:get(agent: Agent): Goal.zh: 全新视图；当前没有目标时为 `undefined`。

cordis-api:goals:disarm(agent: Agent): G.en: Remove process-local continuation authority without changing durable goal phase or revision. Lifecycle owners use this before unloading a driver; a later human-authorized resume records the new activation edge.
cordis-api:goals:disarm(agent: Agent): G.zh: 移除进程本地的延续权限，而不改变持久目标阶段或修订号。生命周期所有者会在卸载驱动器之前使用它；之后由人类授权的 resume 会记录新的激活边界。

cordis-api:goals:disarm(agent: Agent): G.en: a fresh disarmed view, or `undefined` when no goal is current.
cordis-api:goals:disarm(agent: Agent): G.zh: 全新的已解除武装视图；当前没有目标时为 `undefined`。

cordis-api:goals:create(agent: Agent, re.en: Create and arm a goal. A completed goal may be replaced; every other current phase must be cleared or resumed instead.
cordis-api:goals:create(agent: Agent, re.zh: 创建并武装一个目标。已完成的目标可以被替换；其他任何当前阶段都必须改为清除或恢复。
目标描述和可选的轮次上限。

cordis-api:goals:@Remote('edit') edit(ag.en: Edit objective and/or round cap without changing phase.
cordis-api:goals:@Remote('edit') edit(ag.zh: 编辑目标描述和/或轮次上限，不改变阶段。

cordis-api:goals:@Remote('pause') pause(.en: Pause an active goal and disarm automatic continuation.
cordis-api:goals:@Remote('pause') pause(.zh: 暂停活动目标并解除自动延续的武装。

cordis-api:goals:@Remote('resume') resum.en: Resume and arm a stopped goal, or rearm an active goal after a session-start edge, while its round budget still has capacity.
cordis-api:goals:@Remote('resume') resum.zh: 恢复并武装已停止的目标，或在会话启动边界之后重新武装活动目标——前提是其轮次预算仍有容量。

cordis-api:goals:@Remote('complete') com.en: Mark a current non-complete goal complete and disarm it.
cordis-api:goals:@Remote('complete') com.zh: 将当前未完成的目标标记为已完成并解除其武装。

cordis-api:goals:block(agent: Agent, ref.en: Mark an active goal blocked and disarm it.
cordis-api:goals:block(agent: Agent, ref.zh: 将活动目标标记为受阻并解除其武装。

cordis-api:goals:block(agent: Agent, ref.en: policy-owned stable code and human-readable explanation.
cordis-api:goals:block(agent: Agent, ref.zh: 策略拥有的稳定代码和人类可读的说明。

cordis-api:goals:block(agent: Agent, ref.en: the blocked view with its durable reason.
cordis-api:goals:block(agent: Agent, ref.zh: 带有其持久原因的受阻视图。

cordis-api:goals:@Remote('clear') clear(.en: Clear the current goal while retaining a durable tombstone and history.
cordis-api:goals:@Remote('clear') clear(.zh: 清除当前目标，同时保留持久墓碑和历史。

cordis-api:goals:@Remote('clear') clear(.en: the tombstone ref whose revision is one past the cleared snapshot.
cordis-api:goals:@Remote('clear') clear(.zh: 墓碑 ref，其修订号比被清除的快照多一。

cordis-api:goals:@Remote('create') remot.en: Create one Goal through the remote boundary.
cordis-api:goals:@Remote('create') remot.zh: 通过远程边界创建一个 Goal。

cordis-api:goals:@Remote('create') remot.en: exact live Agent resolved from the wire identity.
cordis-api:goals:@Remote('create') remot.zh: 从线上身份解析出的确切活动 Agent。
目标描述和可选的轮次上限。
已创建的 Goal 身份。

cordis-api:jobs:abstract kill(id: JobId,.zh: 进行中的工作返回 `requested`，否则返回 `already-finished`。

cordis-api:jobs:abstract wait(id: JobId,.en: positive finite wait bound in milliseconds.
cordis-api:jobs:abstract wait(id: JobId,.zh: 以毫秒为单位的正有限等待上限。

cordis-api:jobs:abstract wait(id: JobId,.en: optional cancellation of the wait itself.
cordis-api:jobs:abstract wait(id: JobId,.zh: 可选的等待本身的取消。

cordis-api:jobs:abstract attachControlle.en: diagnostic label; duplicate names remain independent.
cordis-api:jobs:abstract attachControlle.zh: 诊断标签；重复名称保持独立。
分离此控制器的释放器。

cordis-api:llm:summary.en: The abstract `llm` service: an adapter registry plus a streaming model-call API, interceptable via the `llm/stream` waterfall.
cordis-api:llm:summary.zh: 抽象 `llm` 服务：一个适配器注册表外加流式模型调用 API，可通过 `llm/stream` 瀑布流拦截。

cordis-api:llm:description.en: The abstract `llm` service: an adapter registry plus a streaming model-call API, interceptable via the `llm/stream` waterfall.
cordis-api:llm:description.zh: 抽象 `llm` 服务：一个适配器注册表外加流式模型调用 API，可通过 `llm/stream` 瀑布流拦截。

cordis-api:llm:registerAdapter(providers.en: Register an adapter for the given provider routes. Throws `LlmError` with code `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER` if any provider already has an adapter (all-or-nothing). Disposed with the fiber.
cordis-api:llm:registerAdapter(providers.zh: 为给定的提供方路由注册适配器。如果任何提供方已有适配器，则抛出代码为 `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER` 的 `LlmError`（全有或全无）。随纤程一起销毁。

cordis-api:llm:registerAdapter(providers.en: every provider route this adapter should serve.
cordis-api:llm:registerAdapter(providers.zh: 此适配器应服务的每个提供方路由。

cordis-api:llm:registerAdapter(providers.en: the adapter that streams calls for those providers.
cordis-api:llm:registerAdapter(providers.zh: 为这些提供方流式处理调用的适配器。

cordis-api:llm:listProviders(): LlmProvi.en: Describe provider routes with a registered adapter.
cordis-api:llm:listProviders(): LlmProvi.zh: 描述已注册适配器的提供方路由。

cordis-api:llm:listProviders(): LlmProvi.en: detached provider metadata in registration order.
cordis-api:llm:listProviders(): LlmProvi.zh: 按注册顺序排列的分离提供方元数据。

cordis-api:llm:registerConfigurableProvi.en: Declare provider routes an adapter plugin can activate through configuration. Registration is all-or-nothing: an empty list, invalid entry, or a provider already declared by any registration throws `LlmError` without registering the rest. Disposed with the fiber.
cordis-api:llm:registerConfigurableProvi.zh: 声明适配器插件可以通过配置激活的提供方路由。注册是全有或全无的：空列表、无效条目或已被任何注册声明过的提供方都会抛出 `LlmError`，且不会注册其余条目。随纤程一起销毁。

cordis-api:llm:registerConfigurableProvi.en: every configurable provider this plugin owns.
cordis-api:llm:registerConfigurableProvi.zh: 此插件拥有的每个可配置提供方。

cordis-api:llm:registerConfigurableProvi.en: a handle that withdraws all of them, and can atomically replace them.
cordis-api:llm:registerConfigurableProvi.zh: 一个可以撤回全部条目、并能原子替换它们的句柄。

cordis-api:llm:listConfigurableProviders.en: List every declared configurable provider, registered or dormant.
cordis-api:llm:listConfigurableProviders.zh: 列出每个已声明的可配置提供方，无论已注册还是休眠。

cordis-api:llm:listConfigurableProviders.en: detached directory entries in declaration order.
cordis-api:llm:listConfigurableProviders.zh: 按声明顺序排列的分离目录条目。

cordis-api:llm:registerModelDiscovery( s.en: Offer to interrogate provider endpoints on behalf of the settings namespace this plugin owns. The namespace is the key because that is what a configuration surface already holds from the configurable-provider directory, and because a provider being *added* has no route to name yet. Disposed with the fiber.
cordis-api:llm:registerModelDiscovery( s.zh: 代表此插件拥有的设置命名空间，提供探查提供方端点的能力。命名空间是关键，因为配置表面已经从可配置提供方目录中持有它，也因为一个正在被 *添加* 的提供方还没有可命名的路由。随纤程一起销毁。

cordis-api:llm:registerModelDiscovery( s.en: the namespace whose profiles this discovery serves.
cordis-api:llm:registerModelDiscovery( s.zh: 此发现所服务的配置文件所属的命名空间。

cordis-api:llm:registerModelDiscovery( s.en: the disposer that withdraws the offer.
cordis-api:llm:registerModelDiscovery( s.zh: 撤回该提供声明的释放器。

cordis-api:llm:async discoverModels( set.en: Interrogate one provider endpoint for the models it advertises. The request describes a draft, not a stored route, so nothing here reads or writes settings or credentials — the caller owns both, and the reply is candidate metadata a surface may offer for adoption.
cordis-api:llm:async discoverModels( set.zh: 探查一个提供方端点以获取其公布的模型。请求描述的是草稿而非已存储路由，因此这里不会读写设置或凭据——两者都由调用者拥有，回复是表面可提供给用户采纳的候选元数据。

cordis-api:llm:async discoverModels( set.en: namespace whose registered discovery serves this draft.
cordis-api:llm:async discoverModels( set.zh: 其注册的发现服务于该草稿的命名空间。

cordis-api:llm:stream(options: GenerateO.en: Stream one model call as raw chunks (token-level deltas). Replay state is retained only when the same adapter instance owns its historical provider and the target provider. Final adapter selection remains fixed through asynchronous exact-model resolution and dispatch. Adapter selection, dispatch, and iteration failures become terminal `error` or `aborted` finish chunks; middleware, nested-call, cleanup, and consumer failures remain thrown.

cordis-api:planMode:set(agent: Agent, ac.en: Select whether plan mode should be active. Between turns the method appends the change immediately because no in-turn pre-step will run until another prompt starts a turn. The open-turn fold is the idle signal: agent status stays `running` through post-turn checkpointing, when no further in-turn pre-step runs. During an open turn the selection remains pending until the next accepted in-turn pre-step. Repeated selection of the current or already-pending state is a no-op.

cordis-api:sessionQuery:async traceEvent.en: target session id and event seq.
cordis-api:sessionQuery:async traceEvent.zh: 目标会话 id 与事件 seq。

cordis-api:sessionQuery:async traceEvent.en: optional cancellation for persisted source resolution.
cordis-api:sessionQuery:async traceEvent.zh: 用于持久化源解析的可选取消信号。

cordis-api:sessionQuery:async traceEvent.en: when source resolution fails, the target is absent, or surface/source-event validation fails.
cordis-api:sessionQuery:async traceEvent.zh: 当源解析失败、目标不存在，或表面/源事件校验失败时。

cordis-api:sessionQuery:async readEvent(.en: Read one full event plus a bounded raw-log context window.
cordis-api:sessionQuery:async readEvent(.zh: 读取一个完整事件外加一个有界的原始日志上下文窗口。
目标会话/seq 与上下文大小。

cordis-api:sessionQuery:async readEvent(.en: optional cancellation for persisted source resolution.
cordis-api:sessionQuery:async readEvent(.zh: 用于持久化源解析的可选取消信号。
目标及其相邻事件的克隆。

cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:summ.en: Exact-read consumer that prepares immutable cross-session message context.
cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:summ.zh: 准备不可变的跨会话消息上下文的精确读取消费者。

cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:desc.en: Exact-read consumer that prepares immutable cross-session message context.
cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:desc.zh: 准备不可变的跨会话消息上下文的精确读取消费者。

cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.en: List reference candidates, ranked by working-directory affinity.
cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.zh: 列出引用候选，按工作目录亲和度排序。

cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.en: target agent; self is excluded and its cwd drives ranking.
cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.zh: 目标代理；自身会被排除，其 cwd 驱动排序。
可选的不区分大小写的 session-id/cwd/title 子串。

cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.en: optional cancellation boundary for host autocomplete teardown.
cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.zh: 用于宿主自动补全清理的可选取消边界。

cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.en: target agent; references to it are rejected.
cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.zh: 目标代理；对它的引用会被拒绝。
已经过宿主归一化的可读消息内容。

cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.en: structured source sessions in mention order.
cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.zh: 按提及顺序排列的结构化源会话。

cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.en: detached content and optional referenced-session context.
cordis-api:sessionReferenceResolver:asyn.zh: 分离的内容和可选的相关会话上下文。

cordis-api:sessions:create(id?: SessionI.en: the session id; omitted, the store mints `session-<n>`.
cordis-api:sessions:create(id?: SessionI.zh: 会话 id；省略时，存储会铸造 `session-<n>`。

cordis-api:sessions:create(id?: SessionI.en: seed events and/or creation metadata for the header.
cordis-api:sessions:create(id?: SessionI.zh: 用于标头的 seed 事件和/或创建元数据。

cordis-api:sessions:create(id?: SessionI.en: the live session, already entered and announced.
cordis-api:sessions:create(id?: SessionI.zh: 活动会话，已进入存储并已宣布。

cordis-api:sessions:create(id?: SessionI.en: if a session with `id` already exists, metadata is not a plain lossless-JSON record with valid scalar fields, or `meta.cwd` is a non-absolute path (storage backends key directories off it).
cordis-api:sessions:create(id?: SessionI.zh: 如果已存在具有 `id` 的会话、元数据不是带有效标量字段的普通无损 JSON 记录，或 `meta.cwd` 不是绝对路径（存储后端以其作为目录键）。

cordis-api:sessions:prepare(id?: Session.en: the session id; omitted, the store mints `session-<n>`.
cordis-api:sessions:prepare(id?: Session.zh: 会话 id；省略时，存储会铸造 `session-<n>`。

cordis-api:sessions:prepare(id?: Session.en: the constructed session, NOT yet in the store.
cordis-api:sessions:prepare(id?: Session.zh: 构造好的会话，尚未进入存储。

cordis-api:sessions:prepare(id?: Session.en: if a session with `id` already exists, metadata is not a plain lossless-JSON record with valid scalar fields, or `meta.cwd` is a non-absolute path.
cordis-api:sessions:prepare(id?: Session.zh: 如果已存在具有 `id` 的会话、元数据不是带有效标量字段的普通无损 JSON 记录，或 `meta.cwd` 不是绝对路径。

cordis-api:sessions:enter(session: Sessi.en: a {@link prepare}d session not yet in the store.
cordis-api:sessions:enter(session: Sessi.zh: 一个已通过 {@link prepare} 准备、尚未进入存储的会话。

cordis-api:sessions:enter(session: Sessi.en: the detach disposer (publication hooks + store removal). When called from a synchronous `session/created` listener, removal and disposal wait until that creation dispatch unwinds.
cordis-api:sessions:enter(session: Sessi.zh: detach 释放器（发布钩子 + 存储移除）。从同步的 `session/created` 监听器中调用时，移除与释放会一直等到该创建派发展开完毕。

cordis-api:sessions:enter(session: Sessi.en: if a session with this id is already in the store.
cordis-api:sessions:enter(session: Sessi.zh: 如果具有此 id 的会话已在存储中。

cordis-api:sessions:announce(session: Se.en: Emit `session/created` exactly once for an entered session (with the carrier enter captured). Separate from enter so the caller can yield the detach disposer first (rollback safety — see enter).
cordis-api:sessions:announce(session: Se.zh: 对一个已进入的会话恰好触发一次 `session/created`（携带进入时捕获的 carrier）。与 enter 分离，以便调用方可以先让出 detach 释放器（回滚安全性——参见 enter）。

cordis-api:sessions:announce(session: Se.en: the entered session to announce to listeners.
cordis-api:sessions:announce(session: Se.zh: 要向监听器宣布的已进入会话。

cordis-api:sessions:announce(session: Se.en: if the session is not live or its announcement already began, including a reentrant call from a creation listener.
cordis-api:sessions:announce(session: Se.zh: 如果会话不是活动的或它的宣布已经开始，包括来自创建监听器的重入调用。

cordis-api:sessions:async flush(session:.en: the session whose buffered events must reach durable storage.
cordis-api:sessions:async flush(session:.zh: 其缓冲事件必须到达持久存储的会话。

cordis-api:sessions:async flush(session:.en: whether at least one durability listener participated, after every listener has settled successfully.
cordis-api:sessions:async flush(session:.zh: 在每一个监听器都成功稳定之后，是否至少有一个持久性监听器参与。

cordis-api:sessions:async flush(session:.en: the first registered listener failure after every listener settles.
cordis-api:sessions:async flush(session:.zh: 在所有监听器稳定之后，第一个注册监听器的失败。

cordis-api:sessions:get(id: SessionId):.en: the session id to look up.
the session, or undefined when no live session has that id.
cordis-api:sessions:get(id: SessionId):.zh: 该会话；当没有活动会话具有该 id 时为 undefined。

cordis-api:sessions:list(): Session[]:de.en: All live sessions, in creation order.
cordis-api:sessions:list(): Session[]:de.zh: 所有活动会话，按创建顺序。

cordis-api:sessions:list(): Session[]:re.en: a fresh array; mutating it does not affect the store.
cordis-api:sessions:list(): Session[]:re.zh: 一个新数组；修改它不会影响存储。

cordis-api:sessions:fork(source: Session.en: Live source session object or id.
cordis-api:sessions:fork(source: Session.zh: 活动源会话对象或 id。

cordis-api:sessionTelemetry:abstract emi.en: the logical record to report; owned by the backend after the call.
cordis-api:sessionTelemetry:abstract emi.zh: 要上报的逻辑记录；调用后由后端接管所有权。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:summary.en: Log-backed title fold plus asynchronous fallback generation.
cordis-api:sessionTitle:summary.zh: 基于日志的标题折叠，外加异步回退生成。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:description.en: Log-backed title fold plus asynchronous fallback generation.
cordis-api:sessionTitle:description.zh: 基于日志的标题折叠，外加异步回退生成。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:get(session: Ses.en: Read the latest folded title from one live or replayed session.
cordis-api:sessionTitle:get(session: Ses.zh: 从单个实时或重放中的会话读取最新的折叠标题。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:get(session: Ses.en: session whose log is the title source of truth.
cordis-api:sessionTitle:get(session: Ses.zh: 其日志作为标题事实来源的会话。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:get(session: Ses.en: latest title snapshot, or `undefined` before eligible input.
cordis-api:sessionTitle:get(session: Ses.zh: 最新的标题快照；在出现合格输入之前为 `undefined`。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:rename(session:.en: Accept an explicit user title. Appends a `session/title` event with the `user` source, which pins the title: in-flight automatic generation is superseded and later user messages schedule none (an explicit SessionTitleService.refresh remains the deliberate unpin).
cordis-api:sessionTitle:rename(session:.zh: 接受一个明确的用户标题。追加一个来源为 `user` 的 `session/title` 事件，从而固定标题：正在进行的自动生成会被取代，之后的用户消息不会再安排生成（显式的 SessionTitleService.refresh 仍是刻意解除固定的方式）。
要重命名的确切实时会话。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:rename(session:.en: raw user input; normalized before acceptance.
cordis-api:sessionTitle:rename(session:.zh: 原始用户输入；接受前会进行规范化。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:async refresh(se.en: Explicitly retry the registered provider, or materialize the built-in fallback when no provider is registered.
cordis-api:sessionTitle:async refresh(se.zh: 显式重试已注册的提供方；若未注册任何提供方，则具体化内置的回退生成。
要刷新的确切实时会话。
可选的调用方取消信号。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:async refresh(se.en: latest accepted title, or `undefined` when no eligible text exists.
cordis-api:sessionTitle:async refresh(se.zh: 最新被接受的标题；当不存在合格文本时为 `undefined`。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:register(provide.en: provider identity, cadence, and generation function.
cordis-api:sessionTitle:register(provide.zh: 提供方的身份、节奏（cadence）与生成函数。

cordis-api:sessionTitle:register(provide.en: exact Cordis effect disposer, which settles after active calls quiesce.
cordis-api:sessionTitle:register(provide.zh: 确切的 Cordis effect 释放器，它会在活动调用归于静默后收敛完成。

cordis-api:shell:summary.zh: 抽象的 bash 执行服务。

cordis-api:shell:abstract resolve(reques.en: Apply implementation-owned defaults and caps to a request before execution.
cordis-api:shell:abstract resolve(reques.zh: 在执行前将实现方拥有的默认值和上限应用于请求。

cordis-api:shell:abstract run(spec: Shel.en: a resolved spec from {@link resolve}, never a raw request.
cordis-api:shell:abstract run(spec: Shel.zh: 来自 {@link resolve} 的已解析 spec，绝不是原始请求。

cordis-api:shell:abstract start(spec: Sh.en: a resolved spec from {@link resolve}, never a raw request.
cordis-api:shell:abstract start(spec: Sh.zh: 来自 {@link resolve} 的已解析 spec，绝不是原始请求。

cordis-api:shellEnv:summary.zh: 用于可信的、每次执行生成的 `DSH_*` 变量的注册表（`ctx.shellEnv`）。

cordis-api:shellEnv:register(contributor.en: Register one environment contributor. Names and keys are unique; built-in keys are reserved. Registration is disposed with the calling plugin fiber.
cordis-api:shellEnv:register(contributor.zh: 注册一个环境贡献者。名称与键唯一；内置键被保留。注册随调用方插件纤程一同释放。

cordis-api:shellEnv:register(contributor.en: declared key ownership and per-execution resolver.
cordis-api:shellEnv:register(contributor.zh: 声明的键所有权与每次执行的解析器。

cordis-api:shellEnv:register(contributor.en: the disposer that unregisters the contribution.
cordis-api:shellEnv:register(contributor.zh: 用于注销该贡献的释放器。

cordis-api:shellEnv:collect(execution: T.en: Build the trusted `DSH_*` snapshot for one shell tool execution.
cordis-api:shellEnv:collect(execution: T.zh: 为一次 shell 工具执行构建可信的 `DSH_*` 快照。

cordis-api:shellEnv:collect(execution: T.en: an immutable environment overlay containing built-ins and current contributions.
cordis-api:shellEnv:collect(execution: T.zh: 包含内置项与当前贡献的不可变环境覆盖层。

cordis-api:shellEnv:list(): BashEnvVaria.en: Enumerate plugin-contributed variables without executing their resolvers.
cordis-api:shellEnv:list(): BashEnvVaria.zh: 枚举插件贡献的变量，而不执行其解析器。

cordis-api:shellEnv:list(): BashEnvVaria.en: declarations sorted by environment variable name.
cordis-api:shellEnv:list(): BashEnvVaria.zh: 按环境变量名称排序的声明。

cordis-api:skills:summary.en: Layered registry of skill providers, the host+per-scope shape the tools registry established.
cordis-api:skills:summary.zh: 技能提供方的分层注册表，采用工具注册表确立的宿主+按作用域（host+per-scope）形态。

cordis-api:skills:registerProvider(creat.en: the exact Cordis effect disposer that unregisters this provider; composite effects may yield it directly to preserve teardown ordering.
cordis-api:skills:registerProvider(creat.zh: 用于注销该提供方的确切 Cordis effect 释放器；组合 effect 可以直接让出（yield）它以保持拆卸顺序。

cordis-api:skills:register(skill: SkillR.en: the skill definition input; omitted invocation and provider fields receive defaults.
cordis-api:skills:register(skill: SkillR.zh: 技能定义输入；省略的调用与提供方字段会获得默认值。

cordis-api:skills:register(skill: SkillR.en: the exact Cordis effect disposer, preserving composite teardown order and invalidating caches.
cordis-api:skills:register(skill: SkillR.zh: 确切的 Cordis effect 释放器，保持组合拆卸顺序并使缓存失效。

cordis-api:skills:async list(options: Sk.en: List invocation-neutral skill summaries for a workspace. Consumers apply model or user invocation policy at their operational boundary. Lookup options and provider candidates are readonly same-process values borrowed throughout discovery.
cordis-api:skills:async list(options: Sk.zh: 列出一个工作区的与调用无关的技能摘要。消费者在其操作边界应用模型或用户的调用策略。查找选项与提供方候选是在整个发现过程中借用的只读同进程值。
所有排序后的胜出摘要。

cordis-api:skills:async snapshot(options.en: Observe the current invocation-neutral catalog and whether discovery completed within a stable revision. Incomplete observations are never cached, allowing consumers to retain last-good state and retry on their next request boundary.
cordis-api:skills:async snapshot(options.zh: 观察当前的与调用无关的目录，以及发现是否在稳定的修订号内完成。不完整的观察结果绝不会被缓存，这允许消费者保留最后已知的良好状态，并在下一个请求边界重试。
排序后的摘要，外加发现完成度状态。

cordis-api:skills:async get(name: string.en: Load and validate the winning candidate, passing its opaque discovery locator back to the provider. Cancellation is rechecked after selection, including cache hits, and raced against loading so an uncooperative provider cannot hang the caller.
cordis-api:skills:async get(name: string.zh: 加载并校验胜出候选，将其不透明的发现定位符回传给提供方。选择之后会重新检查取消，包括缓存命中，并与加载过程竞争，因此不配合的提供方无法挂起调用方。

cordis-api:skills:async get(name: string.en: the full skill, including body content, or `undefined`.
cordis-api:skills:async get(name: string.zh: 完整技能（包括主体内容），或 `undefined`。

cordis-api:spillStore:abstract saveText(.en: Persist `input.content` to a session-scoped spill artifact.
cordis-api:spillStore:abstract saveText(.zh: 将 `input.content` 持久化为一个会话作用域内的溢出产物。

cordis-api:spillStore:abstract saveText(.en: the owner, caller-supplied source fields, suggested name, and full text to save.
cordis-api:spillStore:abstract saveText(.zh: 所有者、调用方提供的源字段、建议名称以及要保存的完整文本。

cordis-api:storage:description.en: The storage hub service. Backends register under `backend`; data forms mount under their `StorageForms` key and are reached as `ctx.storage.<form>`.
cordis-api:storage:description.zh: 存储中枢（hub）服务。后端在 `backend` 下注册；数据形态在其 `StorageForms` 键下挂载，并通过 `ctx.storage.<form>` 访问。

cordis-api:storage:readonly backend: Bac.en: Named backend table; multiple backends stay mounted side by side.
cordis-api:storage:readonly backend: Bac.zh: 命名后端表；多个后端可并排保持挂载。

cordis-api:storage:mount<K extends keyof.en: Mount a data-form facility on the hub. Mounting is an effect: the returned disposer unmounts the form.
cordis-api:storage:mount<K extends keyof.zh: 在枢纽上挂载一个数据形态设施。挂载是一个 effect：返回的释放器会卸载该形态。
在 {@link StorageForms} 中声明的形态键。

cordis-api:storage:mount<K extends keyof.en: the disposer that unmounts the form.

cordis-api:storage:form<K extends keyof.zh: 解析一个已挂载的数据形态。
在 {@link StorageForms} 中声明的形态键。

cordis-api:storageDomain:description.en: The mounted domain facility. Opens declared domains over routed backends; one facility instance owns the open-domain table and enforces single-open per domain name.
cordis-api:storageDomain:description.zh: 已挂载的域设施。在路由后的后端之上打开已声明的域；一个设施实例持有已打开域的表，并对每个域名称强制单开（single-open）。

cordis-api:storageDomain:async open<S ex.en: the opened domain handle, typed by the spec.
cordis-api:storageDomain:async open<S ex.zh: 已打开的域句柄，由 spec 提供类型。

cordis-api:storageDomain:get(name: strin.en: the open domain runtime, or `undefined` when not open.
cordis-api:storageDomain:get(name: strin.zh: 已打开域的运行时；未打开时为 `undefined`。

cordis-api:storageDomain:async closeAll(.en: Close every domain still open on this facility. The unmount path for consumers that never called `Domain.close()` themselves; closing is idempotent, so double-closing an already-closed domain is harmless.
cordis-api:storageDomain:async closeAll(.zh: 关闭该设施上所有仍处于打开状态的域。这是为那些从未自行调用 `Domain.close()` 的消费者提供的卸载路径；关闭是幂等的，因此对已关闭的域再次关闭是无害的。

cordis-api:storageDomain:async closeAll(.en: resolution after every unit is released.
cordis-api:storageDomain:async closeAll(.zh: 在每个单元都被释放后解析完成。

cordis-api:subagents:interrupt(targetSes.en: the durable child session id to interrupt.
cordis-api:subagents:interrupt(targetSes.zh: 要中断的持久子会话 id。

cordis-api:subagents:interrupt(targetSes.en: the human parent address or exact live ancestor Agent.
cordis-api:subagents:interrupt(targetSes.zh: 人工父地址或确切在线祖先 Agent。

cordis-api:subagents:interrupt(targetSes.en: {SubagentError} `UNAUTHORIZED` when the authority does not own the live target.
cordis-api:subagents:interrupt(targetSes.zh: 当权限方不拥有该在线目标时抛出 {SubagentError} `UNAUTHORIZED`。

cordis-api:subagents:registerContinuable.zh: 确切的 Cordis effect 释放器。

cordis-api:subagents:async drainContinua.en: exact host-owned parent Agents entering teardown.
cordis-api:subagents:async drainContinua.zh: 进入拆卸流程的确切宿主拥有的父 Agent。

cordis-api:subagents:async drainContinua.en: an aggregate error after all branches settle when any failed.
cordis-api:subagents:async drainContinua.zh: 当任何分支失败时，在所有分支结束后抛出聚合错误。

cordis-api:subagents:registerProvider(pr.en: Register a provider under its name. Registration is effect-scoped and HMR safe; removing a provider blocks new starts but does not revoke runs that were already returned to their holders.
cordis-api:subagents:registerProvider(pr.zh: 以其名称注册一个提供方。注册按 effect 作用域生效且对 HMR 安全；移除提供方会阻止新的启动，但不会撤销已经返回给其持有者的运行。
确切的 Cordis effect 释放器。

cordis-api:subagents:getProvider(name: s.en: Look up a provider by name.
the provider, or undefined when absent.
cordis-api:subagents:getProvider(name: s.zh: 提供方，缺席时返回 undefined。

cordis-api:subagents:list(): string[]:de.en: List registered provider names in insertion order.
cordis-api:subagents:list(): string[]:de.zh: 按插入顺序列出已注册的提供方名称。

cordis-api:subprocess:abstract resolveEx.en: absolute executable path or bare PATH name.
cordis-api:subprocess:abstract resolveEx.zh: 绝对可执行文件路径或裸 PATH 名称。

cordis-api:subprocess:abstract resolveEx.en: explicit environment entries used for lookup.
cordis-api:subprocess:abstract resolveEx.zh: 用于查找的显式环境条目。
规范化后的可执行文件路径。

cordis-api:subprocess:abstract spawn(spe.en: Start one managed child process from a fully-specified spec; this seam applies no defaults.
cordis-api:subprocess:abstract spawn(spe.zh: 根据完全指定的 spec 启动一个受管子进程；该接缝不应用任何默认值。

cordis-api:subprocess:abstract spawn(spe.en: argv, directory, stdio dispositions, grace, cancellation, and environment.
cordis-api:subprocess:abstract spawn(spe.zh: argv、目录、stdio 配置、宽限期、取消信号与环境。

cordis-api:subprocess:abstract spawn(spe.en: the live process handle (streams/readers, signalling, outcome promise).
cordis-api:subprocess:abstract spawn(spe.zh: 在线进程句柄（流/读取器、信号发送、结果 promise）。

cordis-api:subprocess:abstract spawnTerm.en: fully specified argv, cwd, environment, dimensions, grace, and allocation cancellation.
cordis-api:subprocess:abstract spawnTerm.zh: 完全指定的 argv、cwd、环境、尺寸、宽限期与分配取消信号。

cordis-api:subprocess:abstract spawnTerm.en: the live terminal handle after allocation succeeds.

cordis-api:tools:async execute(exec: Too.en: Execute through pre-policy, guards, around-dispatch, post-policy, definition-owned content finalization, and final notification. Cancellation arriving after entry and before final result materialization skips a not-yet-started body with `ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH` or replaces a successful started outcome with `ABORTED`; already-started work is still drained and may retain a tool-owned structured error.

cordis-api:event:agent/turn-stopping:sum.en: The turn is about to close: the model owes no response (no live tool calls, no fresh steering).

cordis-api:event:agent/turn-stopping:des.en: The turn is about to close: the model owes no response (no live tool calls, no fresh steering). Awaited before the boundary commits — a listener that objects steers (`agent.steer(...)`) and the machine re-reads its inbox: fresh steering runs another step, none closes the turn. Data decides, so listener order cannot change the outcome. The inverse control (stop a tool loop early) is data too: a tool result carrying `concludesTurn` ends the turn at its step. The conclusion never short-circuits already-submitted next-step work: same-step `additionalContexts` or racing steering still runs, and the turn closes only when that inbox drains.
cordis-api:event:agent/turn-stopping:des.zh: 回合即将关闭：模型不再欠有响应（没有活动的工具调用，也没有新的转向指令）。在边界提交前等待——持异议的监听器发出转向（`agent.steer(...)`），机器重新读取其收件箱：新的转向会再运行一个步骤，没有转向则关闭回合。由数据决定，因此监听器顺序无法改变结果。反向控制（提前停止工具循环）同样是数据：带有 `concludesTurn` 的工具结果会在其步骤处结束回合。该结论绝不会短路已提交的下一步工作：同步骤的 `additionalContexts` 或竞态的转向仍会运行，只有当该收件箱排空时回合才关闭。

cordis-api:event:cordis/inspect-query-re.en: Notify every Client that an inspect query has settled or been cancelled.
cordis-api:event:cordis/inspect-query-re.zh: 通知每个 Client：一个检查查询已完结或被取消。

cordis-api:event:cordis/inspect-query-re.en: exact query identity that is no longer answerable.
cordis-api:event:cordis/inspect-query-re.zh: 不再可应答的确切查询身份。

cordis-api:event:cordis/request-run:summ.en: A Client-bearing activation needs a browser page, and may require a user decision.
cordis-api:event:cordis/request-run:summ.zh: 一个带 Client 的激活需要浏览器页面，并且可能需要用户决定。

cordis-api:event:cordis/request-run:desc.en: A Client-bearing activation needs a browser page, and may require a user decision.
cordis-api:event:cordis/request-run:desc.zh: 一个带 Client 的激活需要浏览器页面，并且可能需要用户决定。

cordis-api:event:cordis/request-run:para.en: correlation identity, owner, target version, mode, and approval requirement.
cordis-api:event:cordis/request-run:para.zh: 关联身份、所有者、目标版本、模式和审批要求。

cordis-api:event:cordis/request-run-reso.en: A pending Client activation request left the answerable state.
cordis-api:event:cordis/request-run-reso.zh: 一个待处理的 Client 激活请求已离开可应答状态。

cordis-api:event:cordis/request-run-reso.en: A pending Client activation request left the answerable state.
cordis-api:event:cordis/request-run-reso.zh: 一个待处理的 Client 激活请求已离开可应答状态。

cordis-api:event:credentials/updated:sum.en: Committed change to a provider-managed credential source: a `set`, an `unset`, or an external edit observed in storage.
cordis-api:event:credentials/updated:sum.zh: 对提供方管理的凭据来源的已提交更改：一次 `set`、一次 `unset`，或在存储中观察到的外部编辑。

cordis-api:event:credentials/updated:par.en: the reference whose stored value changed.
cordis-api:event:credentials/updated:par.zh: 存储值发生变化的引用。

cordis-api:event:domain/changed:summary.en: A domain record or the global singleton changed, emitted once per write strictly after the backend acknowledged durability.
cordis-api:event:domain/changed:summary.zh: 一个域记录或全局单例发生变化，每次写入严格在后端确认持久性之后触发一次。

cordis-api:event:domain/changed:descript.en: A domain record or the global singleton changed, emitted once per write strictly after the backend acknowledged durability. Events of one domain arrive in its write-chain order.
cordis-api:event:domain/changed:descript.zh: 一个域记录或全局单例发生变化，每次写入严格在后端确认持久性之后触发一次。同一域的事件按其写入链顺序到达。

cordis-api:event:fs/edit-intent:summary.en: Single-slot decision for the next FileSystem.editText.
cordis-api:event:fs/edit-intent:summary.zh: 对下一次 FileSystem.editText 的单槽位决定。

cordis-api:event:fs/edit-intent:descript.en: Single-slot decision for the next FileSystem.editText. Calling `next()` yields an unconditional edit; the first returned guard wins.
cordis-api:event:fs/edit-intent:descript.zh: 对下一次 FileSystem.editText 的单槽位决定。调用 `next()` 会产生一次无条件编辑；第一个返回的守卫生效。

cordis-api:event:fs/edit-intent:param:ta.en: the resolved target about to be edited.
cordis-api:event:fs/edit-intent:param:ta.zh: 即将被编辑的已解析目标。

cordis-api:event:fs/edit-intent:param:ac.en: the opaque tool-execution context the decider keys off.
cordis-api:event:fs/edit-intent:param:ac.zh: 决策者依据的不透明工具执行上下文。

cordis-api:event:fs/observed:summary.en: Record an authoritative positive or negative observation.
cordis-api:event:fs/observed:summary.zh: 记录一次权威的肯定或否定观察。

cordis-api:event:fs/observed:description.en: Record an authoritative positive or negative observation. Listeners must be synchronous recorders: throws fail the tool call and returned promises are not awaited.
cordis-api:event:fs/observed:description.zh: 记录一次权威的肯定或否定观察。监听器必须是同步记录器：抛出异常会使工具调用失败，返回的 Promise 不会被等待。

cordis-api:event:fs/observed:param:targe.en: the target whose presence or absence was observed.
cordis-api:event:fs/observed:param:targe.zh: 其存在或缺失被观察到的目标。

cordis-api:event:fs/observed:param:obser.en: present with its version, or confirmed absent.
cordis-api:event:fs/observed:param:obser.zh: 带有其版本的存在，或确认缺失。

cordis-api:event:fs/observed:param:actor.en: the observing tool-execution context; undefined records nothing useful.
cordis-api:event:fs/observed:param:actor.zh: 进行观察的工具执行上下文；undefined 不会记录任何有用信息。

cordis-api:event:fs/write-intent:summary.en: Single-slot decision for the next FileSystem.writeText.
cordis-api:event:fs/write-intent:summary.zh: 对下一次 FileSystem.writeText 的单槽位决定。

cordis-api:event:fs/write-intent:param:t.en: the resolved target about to be written.
cordis-api:event:fs/write-intent:param:t.zh: 即将被写入的已解析目标。

cordis-api:event:fs/write-intent:param:a.en: the opaque tool-execution context the decider keys off.
cordis-api:event:fs/write-intent:param:a.zh: 决策者依据的不透明工具执行上下文。

cordis-api:event:goal/changed:summary.en: Goal mutation accepted by one live agent.
cordis-api:event:goal/changed:summary.zh: 一个活动代理接受的目标变更。

cordis-api:event:goal/changed:descriptio.en: Goal mutation accepted by one live agent. The matching `goal/change` session event has already committed. Listener failures are contained. Scope-filtered dispatch (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope`): agent-scoped listeners receive only that agent.
cordis-api:event:goal/changed:descriptio.zh: 一个活动代理接受的目标变更。相应的 `goal/change` 会话事件已经提交。监听器失败会被包含。作用域过滤派发（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope`）：代理作用域监听器只会收到该代理。

cordis-api:event:goal/changed:param:payl.en: .change - fresh current projection or clear tombstone.
cordis-api:event:goal/changed:param:payl.zh: .change - 最新的当前投影或清除墓碑。

cordis-api:event:llm/adapters-updated:su.en: The provider topology changed: an adapter registered or unregistered routes, or the configurable-provider directory gained or lost entries.
cordis-api:event:llm/adapters-updated:su.zh: 提供方拓扑已更改：适配器注册或注销了路由，或可配置提供方目录新增或移除了条目。

cordis-api:event:llm/adapters-updated:de.en: The provider topology changed: an adapter registered or unregistered routes, or the configurable-provider directory gained or lost entries. This payload-free registry notification fires at each commit point (including registration disposal); consumers re-read `listProviders()`, `listModels()`, or `listConfigurableProviders()` for the new state. Observer failures are contained and cannot veto the registry mutation.
cordis-api:event:llm/adapters-updated:de.zh: 提供方拓扑已更改：适配器注册或注销了路由，或可配置提供方目录新增或移除了条目。这个无负载的注册表通知在每个提交点（包括注册的释放）触发；消费方重新读取 `listProviders()`、`listModels()` 或 `listConfigurableProviders()` 以获取新状态。观察者失败会被包含，无法否决注册表变更。

cordis-api:event:llm/stream:summary.en: Waterfall around every streaming model call (retry, replay, routing).
cordis-api:event:llm/stream:summary.zh: 围绕每次流式模型调用的瀑布（重试、重放、路由）。

cordis-api:event:session-telemetry/recor.en: Transform one outbound record before it reaches the backend.
cordis-api:event:session-telemetry/recor.zh: 在一条出站记录到达后端之前对其进行转换。

cordis-api:event:session/created:summary.zh: 会话发布期间的创建公告。

cordis-api:event:session/created:param:s.en: the session just entered and announced.

cordis-api:event:session/disposed:summar.en: Emitted once when an announced session leaves the store, including publication rollback, but never for an entry whose creation announcement did not begin.
cordis-api:event:session/disposed:summar.zh: 当已公告的会话离开存储时触发一次，包括发布回滚，但绝不会为创建公告尚未开始的条目触发。

cordis-api:event:session/disposed:descri.en: Emitted once when an announced session leaves the store, including publication rollback, but never for an entry whose creation announcement did not begin. Listener failures are logged and contained. Scope-filtered dispatch (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope`) reuses the owner scope.
cordis-api:event:session/disposed:descri.zh: 当已公告的会话离开存储时触发一次，包括发布回滚，但绝不会为创建公告尚未开始的条目触发。监听器失败会被记录并包含。作用域过滤派发（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope`）复用所有者作用域。

cordis-api:event:session/disposed:param:.en: the session that is no longer live in the store.
cordis-api:event:session/disposed:param:.zh: 在存储中不再活动的会话。

cordis-api:event:session/event:summary.zh: 提交后的即发即弃追加流。

cordis-api:event:session/event:param:eve.en: the appended event, exactly as recorded.
cordis-api:event:session/event:param:eve.zh: 被追加的事件，与记录完全一致。

cordis-api:event:session/flush:summary.en: Awaited parallel durability checkpoint: every listener runs and the caller awaits all of them, with no waterfall veto.
cordis-api:event:session/flush:summary.zh: 被等待的并行持久性检查点：每个监听器都运行，调用方等待所有监听器，没有瀑布否决。

cordis-api:event:session/flush:param:ses.en: the session whose buffered events must reach durable storage.
cordis-api:event:session/flush:param:ses.zh: 其缓冲事件必须到达持久存储的会话。

cordis-api:event:skills/change:summary.en: A skill provider, runtime contribution, or provider-backed catalog may have changed.
cordis-api:event:skills/change:summary.zh: 技能提供方、运行时贡献或提供方支持的目录可能已更改。

cordis-api:event:skills/change:descripti.en: A skill provider, runtime contribution, or provider-backed catalog may have changed. This is an unfiltered invalidation notification; consumers refetch the catalog for their own lookup options. Listener failures are contained and cannot veto the registry mutation.
cordis-api:event:skills/change:descripti.zh: 技能提供方、运行时贡献或提供方支持的目录可能已更改。这是未过滤的失效通知；消费方重新获取目录以获得各自的查找选项。监听器失败会被包含，无法否决注册表变更。

cordis-api:event:subagent/end:summary.zh: 一个已发布的子代理已完结。

cordis-api:event:subagent/end:descriptio.en: A published child settled. Scope-filtered dispatch uses the same delegating parent carrier as `subagent/start`, so the lifecycle pair reaches the same scoped audience.
cordis-api:event:subagent/end:descriptio.zh: 一个已发布的子代理已完结。作用域过滤派发使用与 `subagent/start` 相同的委托父载体，因此生命周期成对事件会到达相同的作用域受众。

cordis-api:event:subagent/end:param:info.en: the run identity and terminal outcome.

cordis-api:event:subagent/provider-added.en: A provider became resolvable in the registry.
cordis-api:event:subagent/provider-added.zh: 一个提供方在注册表中变得可解析。

cordis-api:event:subagent/provider-added.en: A provider became resolvable in the registry.
cordis-api:event:subagent/provider-added.zh: 一个提供方在注册表中变得可解析。

cordis-api:event:subagent/provider-remov.zh: 一个提供方离开了注册表。

cordis-api:event:subagent/provider-remov.en: A provider left the registry. Accepted runs remain holder-owned.
cordis-api:event:subagent/provider-remov.zh: 一个提供方离开了注册表。已接受的运行仍归持有者所有。

cordis-api:event:subagent/provider-remov.en: the provider name that no longer resolves.
cordis-api:event:subagent/provider-remov.zh: 不再可解析的提供方名称。

cordis-api:event:subagent/start:summary.en: A provider established a published child.
cordis-api:event:subagent/start:summary.zh: 一个提供方建立了已发布的子代理。

cordis-api:event:subagent/start:descript.en: A provider established a published child. For in-process providers, `ctx.agents.get(info.id)` resolves during this notification. Scope-filtered dispatch keys the carrier by the delegating parent, so a parent-scoped listener observes only its own delegations. Paired with `subagent/end`.
cordis-api:event:subagent/start:descript.zh: 一个提供方建立了已发布的子代理。对于进程内提供方，`ctx.agents.get(info.id)` 在此通知期间可解析。作用域过滤派发以委托父代理为键对载体进行索引，因此父作用域监听器只会观察到自己的委托。与 `subagent/end` 成对。

cordis-api:event:subagent/start:param:in.en: the provider and published child identity.
cordis-api:event:subagent/start:param:in.zh: 提供方和已发布子代理的身份。

cordis-api:event:system-prompt/assemble:.en: Expert waterfall over the assembled sections, contexts, tools, and variables.
cordis-api:event:system-prompt/assemble:.zh: 对已组合的区段、上下文、工具和变量的专家瀑布。

cordis-api:event:system-prompt/assemble:.en: the mutable assembly built from registered providers.
cordis-api:event:system-prompt/assemble:.zh: 由已注册提供方构建的可变组合。

cordis-api:event:system-prompt/change:su.en: Emitted when any prompt provider changes.
cordis-api:event:system-prompt/change:su.zh: 当任何提示提供方更改时触发。

cordis-api:event:system-prompt/change:de.en: Emitted when any prompt provider changes. This registry notification is unfiltered because a global change affects every scope.
cordis-api:event:system-prompt/change:de.zh: 当任何提示提供方更改时触发。此注册表通知未过滤，因为全局更改会影响每个作用域。

cordis-api:event:tools/change:summary.en: A tool was registered or unregistered, or a scoped restriction changed (the available tool set changed — possibly for one scope only).
cordis-api:event:tools/change:summary.zh: 一个工具已注册或注销，或作用域限制已更改（可用工具集已更改——可能仅针对一个作用域）。

cordis-api:event:tools/code-dispatch-log.en: the parent execution, sub-call identity, and the settled content to log.
cordis-api:event:tools/code-dispatch-log.zh: 父执行、子调用身份，以及要记录的已完结内容。

cordis-api:event:tools/execute:summary.en: Around-dispatch waterfall for timeout, retry, or metrics.
cordis-api:event:tools/execute:summary.zh: 围绕派发的瀑布，用于超时、重试或指标。

cordis-api:event:tools/execute:param:exe.en: the allowed call about to dispatch (name, parsed arguments, caller agent, signal).
cordis-api:event:tools/execute:param:exe.zh: 即将派发的已允许调用（名称、已解析参数、调用方代理、信号）。

cordis-api:event:tools/post-execute:summ.en: Accept, replace, enrich, or block a normalized dispatch result.
cordis-api:event:tools/post-execute:summ.zh: 接受、替换、丰富或阻止规范化的派发结果。

cordis-api:event:tools/post-execute:para.en: the call that just ran (name, parsed arguments, caller agent).
cordis-api:event:tools/post-execute:para.zh: 刚刚运行的调用（名称、已解析参数、调用方代理）。

cordis-api:event:tools/post-execute:para.en: the dispatch outcome a listener may accept, replace, or block.
cordis-api:event:tools/post-execute:para.zh: 监听器可以接受、替换或阻止的派发结果。

cordis-api:event:tools/pre-execute:param.en: the pending call (name, parsed arguments, caller agent).
cordis-api:event:tools/pre-execute:param.zh: 待处理的调用（名称、已解析参数、调用方代理）。

cordis-api:event:tools/result:summary.en: Observe the frozen, lossless-JSON final outcome.
cordis-api:event:tools/result:summary.zh: 观察冻结的、无损 JSON 的最终结果。

cordis-api:event:tools/result:descriptio.en: Observe the frozen, lossless-JSON final outcome. Listener failures are contained. Scope-filtered dispatch (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope`): keyed by `exec.agent`.
cordis-api:event:tools/result:descriptio.zh: 观察冻结的、无损 JSON 的最终结果。监听器失败会被包含。作用域过滤派发（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope`）：以 `exec.agent` 为键。

cordis-api:event:tools/result:param:exec.en: the execution object that traversed the pipeline.
cordis-api:event:tools/result:param:exec.zh: 遍历了管线的执行对象。

cordis-api:event:tools/result:param:resu.en: a deep-frozen snapshot of the final returned result.
cordis-api:event:tools/result:param:resu.zh: 最终返回结果的深度冻结快照。

cordis-api:event:workflow/agent-end:summ.en: One `agent()` call settled (clean result, child failure, or run cancellation).
cordis-api:event:workflow/agent-end:summ.zh: 一次 `agent()` 调用已完结（干净结果、子代理失败或运行取消）。

cordis-api:event:workflow/agent-end:para.en: the call identity plus its outcome.

cordis-api:event:workflow/agent-start:su.en: One `agent()` call established a published child run.
cordis-api:event:workflow/agent-start:su.zh: 一次 `agent()` 调用建立了已发布的子运行。

cordis-api:event:workflow/end:summary.en: A workflow run settled (any stop reason).
cordis-api:event:workflow/end:summary.zh: 一次工作流运行已完结（任意停止原因）。

cordis-api:event:workflow/end:param:resu.en: the outcome data (stop reason, error, agent count) — deliberately WITHOUT the result value (see {@link WorkflowResultInfo}).
cordis-api:event:workflow/end:param:resu.zh: 结果数据（停止原因、错误、代理数量）——刻意不包含结果值（参见 {@link WorkflowResultInfo}）。

cordis-api:event:workflow/log:summary.en: The script emitted a narration line (a `log(message)` call).
cordis-api:event:workflow/log:summary.zh: 脚本输出了一行叙述（一次 `log(message)` 调用）。

cordis-api:event:workflow/log:descriptio.en: The script emitted a narration line (a `log(message)` call).
cordis-api:event:workflow/log:descriptio.zh: 脚本输出了一行叙述（一次 `log(message)` 调用）。

cordis-api:event:workflow/log:param:mess.zh: 被记录的消息，逐字原样。

cordis-api:event:workflow/phase:summary.en: The script entered a phase (a `phase(title)` call) — progress grouping for observers; no execution semantics.
cordis-api:event:workflow/phase:summary.zh: 脚本进入了一个阶段（一次 `phase(title)` 调用）——为观察者进行进度分组；没有执行语义。

cordis-api:event:workflow/phase:descript.en: The script entered a phase (a `phase(title)` call) — progress grouping for observers; no execution semantics.
cordis-api:event:workflow/phase:descript.zh: 脚本进入了一个阶段（一次 `phase(title)` 调用）——为观察者进行进度分组；没有执行语义。
